text: COLLAPSED-PAIR DECISION: THE PRICE AND THE CLASSIFICATION ARE THE SAME CHOICE. Measured against docs/research-launch/MASTER_CATALOG_2026-08-16_SUMMARY.json, the paired rows are: GRP-0426 HEXARELIN 5 mg $49.00 channel 'RUO Research' vs GRP-0402 Hexarelin (5mg) $62.50 channel 'Supplier Catalog / Classification Pending'; GRP-0425 OXYTOCIN 10 mg $59.00 'RUO Research' vs GRP-0407 Oxytocin (10mg) $107.50 'Supplier Catalog / Classification Pending'. The cheaper row in each pair IS the RUO row. So selecting $62.50 / $107.50 does not mean 'same products, higher price' - it means keeping the CLASSIFICATION PENDING row, and under the direct-order rule a classification-pending row is Request Order, never directly orderable. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE NEW P0: choose $49.00/$59.00 and the launch target holds at 111 direct / 27 pending. Choose $62.50/$107.50 and Hexarelin 5mg and Oxytocin 10mg cannot be ordered at all - 109 direct / 29 pending - which is the opposite of what the intake launch wants, and it would be reached by way of a price decision rather than a routing one. Both totals still sum to 139. Samuel should be shown it as one question, not two: 'which row survives', with the price and the order button moving together. I am NOT implementing either direction and I have withdrawn my offer to regenerate the artifact until his call lands, because regenerating bakes in a collapse direction that is actively disputed. Note also that the reviewed config already encodes keeps GRP-0426 at $49.00 and keeps GRP-0425 at $59.00, both channel RUO Research - so if he confirms $62.50/$107.50, config/research/master-catalog-reconciliation-20260821.json is wrong and must change before any regeneration, not after.
